title: Team settings
readOnly: Only Owners and Admins can change this.
ownerOnly: Only the Owner can do this.

planning.modeHint: Weekly plan is default; sprints add Backlog, Sprint and Reviews tabs to Planning
planning.weekStartHint: Follows each user’s setting unless fixed here
planning.checkinsOnHint: Turn off to hide Check-ins for this team
planning.statusHint: Members can set Available / Busy / Away / Off
planning.toSprintsBody: This week’s plan becomes the Sprint 1 draft. Planning gets Backlog, Sprint and Reviews tabs.
planning.toWeeklyBody: A sprint is running. Complete it in Planning, then switch back to the weekly plan.
planning.switchedSprints: Switched to sprints · Sprint 1 draft ready

schedule.title: Weekly check-in schedule
schedule.questions: Three fixed questions: Did · Next · Blocked by.

access.membersInviteHint: If on, Members can invite Viewers

lifecycle.transferHint: Choose an Admin or Lead → they accept → you confirm with your password. You stay Owner until accepted.
lifecycle.noSuccessor: No Admin or Lead to choose
lifecycle.archiveHint: Read-only for everyone; linked projects are not archived
lifecycle.joinCompanyHint: Available in Phase 4 (custody & privacy preview + approvals)
lifecycle.deleteHint: Owner only · type the team name · re-enter password. Team tasks, goals, check-ins and files are deleted; projects stay with their owners.
